origin.description: Shuffle named columns, leaving the others fixed.

arguments.text: Column names. A name like a:b selects the range.

origin.details: Each permutation stores the shuffled row indexes. The same seed matches R's sample.int.
origin.value: A frame with a perm column and an id column.

translation.description: Shuffle named columns, leaving the others fixed.

arguments.text: Column names. A name like a:b selects the range.

translation.details: Each permutation stores the shuffled row indexes. The same seed matches R's sample.int.
translation.value: A frame with a perm column and an id column.
translation.example:
set_seed(1)
print(" ".join(str(i) for i in permute(mtcars, 1, "mpg")["perm"][0].idx[:8]))
